Hey HeliumDeploy team,

I took a look at HeliumDeploy after seeing an ad for your ASIC miner. You fit the exact profile of the home mining brands we scale best.

We work on a commission only basis. Where if we don't generate you sales you don't pay for the work.

Just for context, we took Genepro Protein to over 371k/mo in sales, up 205% in 90 days.

Have you ever considered bringing on a purely performance partner?

Cheers,
Ciaran

--

Ciaran F.
Co-Founder · Linear
LinkedIn - (contact hidden)

Hi Ciaran,

Thanks for reaching out. I handle technical support here, so marketing and partnership proposals are outside what I can act on. I'm not going to pass this one along internally either, since we're not currently looking at performance partners.

Appreciate the interest, and best of luck with Linear.

Hal
HeliumDeploy Technical Support
